implementation: Phison TCG OPAL SSC SSD solutions
description: Phison PS5012-E12 based TCG Opal SSC SSD solutions are high-performance Self-Encrypting SSDs supporting NVMe PCIe Interface. Cryptographic algorithm includes AES256-XTS on-the-fly user data encryption/decryption, RSA-2048 for firmware verification, HMAC_DRBG for key generation as well as AES Keywrap for key protection.
